sourceTitle: Barilla Bacon and Brussels Sprouts Penne
sourceText:
Barilla Bacon and Brussels Sprouts Penne
By: Kevin Anderson
Published: Tuesday, October 6, 2015 - 10:29am

Ingredients




• 1 box	Barilla Protein PLUS Penne
• 2 pounds Brussels sprouts
• 8 slices raw bacon
• 4 cloves garlic, minced
• 1/4 cup shallots, thinly sliced
• 1 tablespoon	olive oil
• 1 cup chicken broth, low-sodium preferred
• 1/4 cup pecans, roasted and chopped
• 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, grated

Preparation

1 Cook pasta according to the package instructions. Preheat oven to 350°F. In a pot of boiling water, blanch Brussels sprouts for 5 minutes; place drained Brussels sprouts on baking pan in fridge to cool. 2 Once cooled, cut sprouts in half. In an oven-safe skillet, cook bacon until crisp, remove and crumble; pour off all but 1 tablespoon of bacon fat. Add garlic and shallots to skillet and sauté until soft. 3 To same skillet add olive oil and Brussels sprouts; bake in a 350°F oven for 10 minutes until caramelized. 4 Remove from oven and add chicken stock; over medium heat, stir well and heat through. Add pasta, bacon and pecans, mixing well. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.

About

Swap ingredients and add seasonal vegetables to give classic dishes a makeover. Simple changes such as using sweet potatoes instead of regular spuds add more nutrients to your meals. Pastas like Barilla Protein PLUS add an array of benefits including 14 grams of high quality protein from chickpeas, lentils and egg whites.
